intro: Astra chair makes dining feel like a warm embrace. With soft cushioning, a supportive curve, and a sturdy base with optional swivel, it adapts to your comfort, whether you sit still or move with ease.

features.title: Cushioning that lets you linger longer
features.text: The plush padding eases pressure points so you can enjoy drawn-out dinners, family catch-ups, or even late-night reading at the table without discomfort.

features.title: Curved backrest that cares for your posture
features.text: Its gentle arc follows the shape of your spine, helping you sit upright naturally while keeping you relaxed through extended hours of use.

features.title: Diverse leg base options to suit your needs
features.text: Enjoy built-in mobility and comfort—swivel smoothly, recline when you want to relax, and move with ease on castors, all while staying balanced and supported.

features.title: Toffee tone that warms every setting
features.text: The deep brown finish blends seamlessly into cozy, rustic spaces or modern dining rooms, creating an inviting atmosphere for every meal.
